title: Fort Point National Historic Site Postcard Booklet San Francisco Golden Gate
condition_description: Complete, intact booklet - no cards detached, unposted and unwritten. Light toning and a faint stain along one edge of the back (pictured).
description:
Vintage souvenir postcard booklet - "6 Detachable Post Cards, Fort Point National Historic Site, San Francisco, California", original 50 cent cover price. Photos by Pierre Atlan (P-24).

Views include:
- Cannon Rooms, Fort Point
- Aerial View - the Golden Gate
- 12 Pounder Napoleon Cannon
- Aerial View of Fort Point
- Sally Port Entrance, Fort Point

Condition: complete and intact - no cards detached, none written on or posted. Light toning and a faint stain along one edge of the back (see photos).

Ships flat with a stiffener in a protective mailer.
